dialogs.about: 딸과 아침을 차리며 식단 이야기를 해요

lines.en: Mom, did you skip breakfast yesterday?
Yes, I was busy, so I skipped it once.
Please don't skip meals. Your body needs protein.
lines.ko: 식사 거르지 마세요. 몸에 단백질이 필요해요.

lines.en: That's right. What should I eat?
Eggs and beans give you good protein and fiber.
lines.ko: 달걀하고 콩이 좋은 단백질하고 섬유질을 줘요.

lines.en: I like eggs. Is my portion too big?
lines.ko: 달걀 좋아해요. 제가 먹는 양이 너무 많아요?

lines.en: A little. A small portion is enough for you.
I stood on the scale after breakfast.
Did you gain weight?
No. I will stay on this diet. Thank you.
lines.ko: 아니요. 이 식단을 계속 지킬게요. 고마워요.

dialogs.about: 보건소에서 영양 선생님께 식단 상담을 받아요

lines.en: Hello. Let's talk about your daily diet.
Thank you. Am I overweight?
No, not at all. Your weight is fine.
Oh, good. Do I eat too much fat?
lines.ko: 아, 다행이에요. 지방을 너무 많이 먹어요?

lines.en: A little. Eat more fiber and less fat.
lines.ko: 조금요. 섬유질을 더 드시고 지방은 줄이세요.

lines.en: I ate two bowls of rice last night. Too much?
lines.ko: 어젯밤에 밥 두 공기를 먹었어요. 너무 많아요?

lines.en: That's a big portion. One is enough.
lines.ko: 그건 양이 많아요. 한 공기면 충분해요.

lines.en: Will I gain weight from sweet food?
Sweet food has a lot of sugar. Eat a little.
lines.ko: 단 음식은 설탕이 많아요. 조금만 드세요.

lines.en: I understand. I will eat a smaller portion.
